rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for olive oil, whether used in cooking or as a salad dressing.

example.english: Add a little olive oil when cooking pasta, and it will smell much better.
example.traditional: 煮意粉嗰陣加少少橄欖油，香好多。
example.jyutping: zyu2 ji3 fan2 go2 zan6 gaa1 siu2 siu2 gaam3 laam2 jau4 hoeng1 hou2 do1
